reading.title: What should schools teach?
reading.text: The current school curriculum in many countries was designed for the industrial age, and I believe it is time for change. Problems such as climate change and online fraud recur in the news every week, yet students rarely discuss them in class. Some teachers argue that the timetable is already full. In my opinion, this is not a reason to do nothing: subjects could be combined, and regular excursions could replace some classroom lessons. It rarely occurs to policymakers that learning how money, interest and currency work may be as useful as algebra.
